# Changes

Source: [blader/napkin](https://github.com/blader/napkin).

Napkin is adapted from upstream commit `27fa60a`: it uses one shared `~/Claude/napkin.md` instead of a per-repository `.claude/napkin.md`.

The included `napkin/README.md` is upstream's README, unchanged, and still describes the per-repository `.claude/napkin.md` approach with a `git clone` into `~/.claude/skills/napkin`. For this adapted copy, `napkin/SKILL.md` is authoritative: it uses one shared `~/Claude/napkin.md`.
